trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Blackbelt
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid physical confrontation with SCP-T051. SCP-T051 must not be allowed near SCP-0068 (Machamp) during agitation cycles.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T051 displays anomalous physical strength and reflexes, capable of matching low-level fighting-type SCP entities in combat. Frequently trains alongside SCP-0066 (Machop) and SCP-0067 (Machoke).
addendum_logs: Addendum T051-A: SCP-T051 shattered reinforced training equipment during a demonstration.
Addendum T051-B: SCP-T051 dodged SCP-0067’s strike at speeds exceeding human reaction time.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Super Nerd
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T052 must not be allowed access to SCP-0088 (Grimer) or SCP-0089 (Muk) without supervision.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T052 displays anomalous chemical intuition, capable of identifying hazardous compounds and creating counteragents using improvised materials.
addendum_logs: Addendum T052-A: SCP-T052 neutralized SCP-0088’s corrosive sludge using improvised chemicals.
Addendum T052-B: SCP-T052 identified airborne toxins before sensors detected them.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Hiker
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T053 may assist in geological SCP containment. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T053 to SCP-0095 (Onix) during agitation.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T053 displays anomalous endurance and resilience to harsh environments. Capable of detecting subterranean SCP entities through vibration patterns.
addendum_logs: Addendum T053-A: SCP-T053 detected SCP-0095 tunneling 40 meters below ground.
Addendum T053-B: SCP-T053 resisted SCP-0075 (Graveler)’s shockwave with minimal injury.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Biker
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid roadways during SCP-T054’s traversal. SCP-T054 must not be allowed near SCP-0128 (Tauros).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T054 displays anomalous control over high-speed vehicles and extreme reaction time. Frequently involved in incidents near SCP containment transport routes.
addendum_logs: Addendum T054-A: SCP-T054 avoided collision with SCP transport vehicle at 120 km/h.
Addendum T054-B: SCP-T054 survived a crash that destroyed containment barriers.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Cue Ball
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-T055. SCP-T055 must not be allowed near SCP-0076 (Golem).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T055 displays anomalous strength and impact force, capable of damaging reinforced materials. Frequently engages in physical altercations.
addendum_logs: Addendum T055-A: SCP-T055 dented reinforced steel with a single strike.
Addendum T055-B: SCP-T055 resisted SCP-0074 (Geodude)’s tackle with no injury.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Burglar
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T056 must be monitored at all times. Personnel must secure all containment keys and digital access points.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T056 displays anomalous infiltration skills and escape capability, frequently targeting SCP storage facilities.
addendum_logs: Addendum T056-A: SCP-T056 bypassed three biometric locks in under 90 seconds.
Addendum T056-B: SCP-T056 escaped containment using improvised tools.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Scientist (Cinnabar)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T057 must not be exposed to SCP-0146 (Moltres) without thermal shielding.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T057 specializes in volcanic anomaly research and displays mild resistance to extreme heat. Frequently collaborates with SCP-T010 (Blaine).
addendum_logs: Addendum T057-A: SCP-T057 stabilized thermal fluctuations caused by SCP-0126 (Magmar).
Addendum T057-B: SCP-T057 operated safely in a 500°C chamber for 3 minutes.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Swimmer
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T058 may assist in aquatic SCP containment. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T058 to SCP-0130 (Gyarados).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T058 displays anomalous aquatic mobility and resilience, capable of navigating hazardous waters safely.
addendum_logs: Addendum T058-A: SCP-T058 outswam SCP-0116 (Horsea) during a containment test.
Addendum T058-B: SCP-T058 resisted SCP-0087 (Dewgong)’s freezing mist.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Beauty
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid allowing SCP-T059 to interact with SCP-0045 (Vileplume) due to pheromone amplification.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T059 displays anomalous charisma capable of influencing both humans and docile SCP entities. Effects intensify during emotional expression.
addendum_logs: Addendum T059-A: SCP-0058 (Growlithe) displayed heightened affection toward SCP-T059.
Addendum T059-B: SCP-0044 (Gloom)’s pheromone output increased in SCP-T059’s presence.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Cooltrainer
abilities: rapid adaptation to multiple anomaly types
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T060 must not be allowed near high-threat SCPs without supervision.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T060 displays anomalous combat adaptability, capable of coordinating with multiple SCP types simultaneously. Frequently used in mixed-type containment drills.
addendum_logs: Addendum T060-A: SCP-T060 neutralized SCP-0054 (Psyduck)’s psychic burst using improvised tactics.
Addendum T060-B: SCP-T060 resisted SCP-0077 (Ponyta)’s flame output with minimal injury.
